subject: Exec Workshop - London: Air pooling & visa triage
messages:
From: Sarah Toomey <sarah.toomey@luminex.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rahul Pandey <rahul.pandey@lum-international.com>, travelops@travelbound.co
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:14:00 +01:00
Subject: London Workshop - initial travel info + airpool idea

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for hosting Luminex for the July exec workshop (July 12-13). We're starting to collate travel details on our side and wanted to propose air-pooling to keep the group together and reduce costs. Draft attendee list attached (luminex_itinerary_v1.pdf).

A few asks from our travel team:
- Can Redwood coordinate a couple of pooled departure windows from SFO (morning and evening) so we can align transfers?
- Any recommended travel agency/PNR process for group bookings?
- One attendee (Rahul Pandey) is on an Indian passport — can you confirm if we should trigger UK visa support or use priority service?

If you want, Rahul can share passport details after we confirm windows. We're flexible but would like seats/meal prefs locked in by end of next week if possible.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if it's easier.

Best,
Sarah
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Luminex Health

Attachment: luminex_itinerary_v1.pdf (stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Toomey <sarah.toomey@luminex.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, travelops@travelbound.co
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: London Workshop - initial travel info + airpool idea

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the draft list. Air-pooling is fine with us; we use TravelBound for group bookings and have a corporate window that gets reasonable fares and flexible change rules. I looped Vanessa and Vivek to align on routing and shuttle coordination.

Quick plan proposal:
- Two pooled departure windows from SFO on July 11: 06:00-09:00 (AM wave) and 16:00-20:00 (PM wave). We will split the Redwood & Luminex execs across both waves to keep team functions intact.
- TravelBound will build a single group PNR per wave and share PNR summary + e-tickets. I'll ask them to send a consolidated passenger_roster.csv for approvals.
- Rahul: for UK travel, Indian passport holders will likely need a standard visa (not ESTA). TravelBound partners can start priority visa submission if you want — that typically takes 3-5 business days plus courier. Please confirm if Rahul wants expedited support and we'll share the DocuSign authorization for visa service.

Action items (for clarity):
- Sarah: confirm which attendees require visa support and collect passport #, expiry, and DOB (send securely to TravelBound ops).
- Vanessa: can you confirm preferred airport for inbound shuttle (LHR terminal 3 vs 5)? We need that to estimate ground transit times and bus charter size.
- Vivek: confirm budget approval for priority visas and optional seat upgrades (we may need a manager sign-off if above $200 per pax).

I'll target a PNR summary by Friday (May 28). If we should push earlier, tell TravelBound to prioritize the AM wave first.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: passenger_roster.csv (will be produced by TravelBound)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Sarah Toomey <sarah.toomey@luminex.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, travelops@travelbound.co
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: London Workshop - initial travel info + airpool idea

Quick notes from routing ops:
- For inbound airport, pick LHR Terminal 3 if the bulk of arrivals are on BA/AA/Oneworld — easier for a single shuttle and luggage handling. Terminal 5 adds 20-30 mins transfer time in off-peak.
- Recommend we prioritize the AM wave for senior execs and split junior staff to the PM wave — keeps rehearsals flexible the afternoon of July 11.
- If TravelBound can hold seats (saver fares) for 48 hours, we should do that and finalize passports before ticketing.

On visas: TravelBound has a direct partner (GlobalVisa) who can collect docs and handle biometrics scheduling in SF; service fee is about $150 + consulate fees. If Rahul needs a full visa submission, timeline is 7-10 business days including biometrics — expedited courier can shave ~2 days. If you want me to approve the expedited fee for Luminex attendees, confirm and I'll route the charge to the LGN-Summit travel PO.

Let me know if anyone has dietary constraints or seat preferences to pass to the airline.

V.

--

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized: PNRs & next steps for London exec workshop (AM wave locked)

Team — quick update and confirmation following TravelBound's work this morning:
- AM wave (SFO departures 06:45-09:10) locked for senior execs. TravelBound created PNRs and attached PNR summary (pnr_summary.pdf). See attached stub.
- Passenger roster has been finalized and is attached as passenger_roster.csv. TravelBound will email individual e-tickets to each traveler.
- Rahul: TravelBound started the priority UK visa workflow; DocuSign link sent for authorization to collect passport scans and process the application. You should receive an email from docusign@docusign.com with subject 'Authorize: GlobalVisa intake' — please complete by EOD tomorrow to keep the expedited timeline.
- Vanessa: please confirm terminal pick (T3 is recommended). We'll book a 16-seat shuttle for arrival and one small cargo van for luggage overspill; estimated ground time to central Cambridge is 50-65 minutes depending on terminal.
- Vivek: we've held the budget for expedited visas and two seat upgrades pending your final OK. Total incremental ~$1,180 across group. If you approve, TravelBound will charge the LGN-Summit PO.

Next steps:
1) Rahul/Sarah: confirm DocuSign completion and passport uploads.
2) Vanessa: confirm terminal T3 and I will instruct TravelBound to finalize exact pickup point.
3) Vivek: approve the PO charge for expedited services.

Thanks everyone — I'll forward the TravelBound e-ticket confirmations when they come through.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pnr_summary.pdf, passenger_roster.csv
